description: Angers Loire Métropole - Réseau Irigo - GTFS & GTFS-RT & SIRI is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by RD Angers. Description (hours of passage, routes and stops) of the Irigo bus-tram network on the territory of Angers Loire Métropole in GTFS format and feed Service alert and Route update in GTFS-RT format. Coverage: RD Angers. The publisher named on the listing is RD Angers. Its keywords include irigo, transports-deplacements, gtfs, gtfs-real-time. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, GTFS, SIRI, GTFS-RT. The listing shows 2025-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
